description: The plot illustrates how evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL.) varies with the activated parameters ratio for several model variants, with a baseline Transformer shown for reference. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” on a linear scale, spanning from 100 to 25, with tick labels at 100, 75, and 25 (decreasing left to right). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” on a linear scale, with labeled ticks from 11.5 up to 14.0 in 0.5 increments. A red dashed horizontal line labeled “Transformer” stays constant at about 11.6 across all x-values. The “Only MoHD FFN” series is a gray solid line with square markers, starting near 11.45 at 100, around 11.5 at 75, dipping to about 11.35 at the intermediate point between 75 and 25, and ending near 11.8 at 25. The “Only MoHD ATTN” series is a dark navy solid line with circular markers, starting near 11.45 at 100, rising to about 11.6 at 75, increasing to roughly 12.25 at the intermediate point, and reaching about 14.3 at 25. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” series is a blue solid line with x-shaped markers, starting near 11.45 at 100, increasing to about 11.55 at 75, rising to around 12.05 at the intermediate point, and ending near 13.2 at 25.
